description: When the user asks to send, share, save, add, or forward something to Carl, CarlNotes, or their Topics without naming a Topic, with phrases like send this to Carl or save this to my topics, call this before send_to_topic and wait for their choice. A named Topic goes straight to send_to_topic. Never call it on your own initiative. Takes the send's title, summary, and links and stores nothing. Preserve an available conversation URL in optional chat_url for the final send. That private reference is excluded from matching and public links. For Codex, preserve codex://threads/<verified-thread-id> when the actual local thread ID is available. Never invent an ID or create a shared conversation link automatically. Returns every Topic you can edit for sending, strongest matches first and recommended, with weaker editable Topics available unchecked. Lists five Topics per page using list_topics cursors; repeat the same content and optional name query with nextCursor. The MCP Apps view supports name autocomplete, filtering, checkboxes, the standard numbered paginator, live selected-topic tag pills, and one explicit send to all selected Topics. View autocomplete uses autocomplete=true for name-only reads without content matching. It shows Steeping only in the results area without changing view height; the header, search, selection, and standard action buttons stay visible. Text-only hosts receive numbered choices. Every page offers Start a new topic for this chat: only after the user picks it, use the existing suggest_sources and create_topic Topic Draft flow and limits, preview a private draft, and create only after confirmation. Both routes search editable destinations; switch to /mcp to send to another Topic from a Topic-bound connection.

autocomplete.description: Card-only editable Topic-name autocomplete. Skips content matching and stores nothing.
